findings.evidenceJa: 灰色の空が茜色に染まった
findings.governingReading: the gray sky was dyed madder-red
findings.explanation: The two-stage color transformation is flattened.

findings.highlight: the black giant turned into sand
findings.evidenceJa: 黒い巨人の亡骸は風化してしまった
findings.governingReading: the black giant’s remains weathered away
findings.explanation: Servant dissolution is presented as direct material transformation into sand.

findings.highlight: He’s not a Servant that should exist
findings.evidenceJa: 既存のサーヴァントじゃなかった
findings.governingReading: he did not appear to be one of the existing Servants
findings.explanation: Rin’s roster observation becomes an ontological prohibition.

findings.highlight: a heroic spirit that dominates all others
findings.evidenceJa: 英霊に対して絶対的に優位な英霊
findings.governingReading: a Heroic Spirit with an absolute advantage over Heroic Spirits
findings.explanation: A categorical matchup property becomes a broad claim that he dominates everyone.

findings.evidenceJa: この世の全てを治めた
findings.governingReading: ruled everything in this world
findings.explanation: Political dominion becomes acquisition.

findings.highlight: You sound like you want to say something
findings.evidenceJa: 奥歯に物が挟まったような言い方
findings.governingReading: you speak as though something were caught between your back teeth
findings.explanation: Rin’s conspicuously evasive manner loses its concrete idiom.

findings.evidenceJa: あいつの強さがどんな物なのか
findings.governingReading: has not realized what kind of strength his is
findings.explanation: Shirou wonders about the nature of Gilgamesh’s advantage, not ignorance of his abilities.

findings.highlight: heroic spirits are as strong as their fame
findings.evidenceJa: 英霊の強さは召喚された土地での知名度による
findings.governingReading: a Heroic Spirit’s strength depends on fame in the land of summoning
findings.explanation: A causal modifier becomes a crude equation.

findings.evidenceJa: いや、だから反則だって
findings.governingReading: no, that is why I say he is unfair
findings.explanation: Shirou’s tactical conclusion is replaced by a stray affirmation.

findings.evidenceJa: 財宝を収納した
findings.governingReading: stored the treasures he collected
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s treasury is narrowed to weapons.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーやランサーのように
findings.governingReading: unlike Saber or Lancer, he is not a wielder
findings.explanation: The concrete model for mastery and its character comparison disappear.

findings.highlight: scratches her cheek while looking away
findings.evidenceJa: あはは、なんて明後日の方角を見ながら頬を掻く
findings.governingReading: scratches her cheek, saying “ahaha,” while looking in a wildly unrelated direction
findings.explanation: Rin’s evasive comic performance loses its laugh and exaggerated gaze.

findings.evidenceJa: “お金持ちっぽい”という嗅覚だけで
findings.governingReading: by scent alone that he seemed rich
findings.explanation: The joke that Rin literally has a nose for wealth disappears.

findings.highlight: There’s not supposed to be an eighth Servant, so he would be the Joker
findings.evidenceJa: 八人目のサーヴァントって時点で破綻してるのに、そいつ自身がジョーカー
findings.governingReading: the roster already breaks at an eighth Servant, and he himself is also a joker
findings.explanation: Two independent dangers are turned into a causal explanation of one label.

findings.highlight: we’ll have a bed to sleep in here
findings.evidenceJa: ここなら夜になっても暖はとれる
findings.governingReading: we can keep warm here even after night falls
findings.explanation: A practical warmth observation becomes unsupported sleeping accommodation.

findings.evidenceJa: 二人だけで裏をかく
findings.governingReading: outwit them with only the two of you
findings.explanation: Lancer mocks their scheming ability, not direct combat victory.

findings.evidenceJa: すぐさま立ち上がって正門に振り向く
findings.governingReading: I immediately stand and turn toward the main gate
findings.explanation: Shirou’s singular action is assigned to both him and Rin.

findings.highlight: It’s great you two are still hanging in there
findings.evidenceJa: お互いしぶとく生き残っているようで何よりだ
findings.governingReading: glad to see we have both stubbornly survived
findings.explanation: Lancer includes himself in a mutual-survival joke; the English addresses only the pair.

findings.evidenceJa: 神経を一気に束ね
findings.governingReading: I gather my nerves into a single bundle
findings.explanation: Shirou’s physical circuit-induction image is generalized to attention.

findings.evidenceJa: 胸を貫かれた
findings.governingReading: he pierced my chest
findings.explanation: The prior wound is relocated from chest to heart.

findings.highlight: She lowers the hand she pointed at Lancer and points at me
findings.evidenceJa: ランサーに向けた左手を下げ、あまつさえ俺の鼻先に向けてくる
findings.governingReading: she lowers her left hand from Lancer and points it at the tip of my nose
findings.explanation: The hand and close-range comic staging disappear.

findings.highlight: This is the second time I’m fighting him
findings.evidenceJa: あいつとは二度目
findings.governingReading: this is my second encounter with him
findings.explanation: Shirou claims prior experience, not that a second fight has already begun.

findings.highlight: Don’t come out with your destructive personality
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の壊し屋っぷりを開き直るな
findings.governingReading: do not defiantly own how much of a destroyer you are
findings.explanation: The comic accusation becomes malformed personality language.

findings.highlight: I can understand Caster not wanting you now
findings.evidenceJa: キャスターが遠坂は要らないもーんって言ってたの、あんまり無視できない
findings.governingReading: we cannot entirely ignore Caster saying she did not need you
findings.explanation: A warning not to dismiss Caster’s criticism becomes Shirou endorsing it.

findings.evidenceJa: お互いがお互いを押しのけようと言い争う
findings.governingReading: we argue while each tries to shove the other aside to take the danger
findings.explanation: The protective contest underlying the comedy disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: にやにやと俺たちを観察
findings.governingReading: watching us with a broad, knowing grin
findings.explanation: Lancer’s amused, teasing expression is neutralized.

findings.evidenceJa: こほん、と反省して
findings.governingReading: I give a chastened little cough
findings.explanation: The pair’s embarrassed self-correction disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 見るに見かねて
findings.governingReading: unable to stand by and watch
findings.explanation: Lancer’s reluctant sympathy is reduced to attention.

findings.evidenceJa: 目が点になる
findings.governingReading: my eyes become dots
findings.explanation: The manga-like comic reaction image disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: オレのマスター
findings.governingReading: my Master wants cooperation
findings.explanation: mirror moon assigns male gender to Lancer’s still-unidentified Master.

findings.highlight: trying to figure out if Lancer knows about them
findings.evidenceJa: 慎二の事を知っているかカマをかけている
findings.governingReading: probing whether Lancer knows about Shinji
findings.explanation: Rin’s precise information-gathering target is broadened to Shinji and Gilgamesh together.

findings.highlight: I don’t want to ally with them
findings.evidenceJa: とてもじゃないが性に合わん
findings.governingReading: they are utterly incompatible with my temperament
findings.explanation: Lancer’s character-based rejection becomes generic preference.

findings.evidenceJa: 俺の趣味だ
findings.governingReading: my personal taste
findings.explanation: Lancer chose them according to taste, not curiosity or stake.

findings.evidenceJa: あっさりと言う
findings.governingReading: he says it casually
findings.explanation: Lancer’s breezy treatment of violence is changed into clarity.

findings.highlight: ‘I’m’ the one who thought that you guys would make good allies
findings.evidenceJa: オマエ達なら協力してやっていいと、このオレが思った
findings.governingReading: I decided you two were people I would deign to cooperate with
findings.explanation: Lancer’s boast about granting his cooperation becomes an unclear assessment of ally quality.

findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂を流し見る
findings.governingReading: casts Tohsaka a sidelong glance
findings.explanation: Lancer’s cool, appraising glance loses its direction and manner.

findings.highlight: we have to break off negotiations
findings.evidenceJa: この話はなかった事にする
findings.governingReading: we will treat this discussion as never having happened
findings.explanation: Rin’s clean erasure of the proposal becomes termination of an established negotiation.

findings.evidenceJa: 器を試されてる
findings.governingReading: your caliber is being tested
findings.explanation: Lancer teases Shirou about capacity or mettle, not moral character.
